'''Leero''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who was a self-proclaimed [[Artist/Legends|artist]] and [[Director/Legends|director]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. However, Leero's [[Holodrama/Legends|holodramas]] were so devoid of taste that they were not sold freely in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], so Leero hired individuals to find a market for them. Surprisingly, a [[Unidentified species (Leero's holodramas)|primitive species]] treated the holodramas as divine messages, and gladly traded their wealth for them.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|No Redeeming Value}}</ref>
